jobs.name: typecheck
jobs.purpose: Validate TypeScript type safety across codebase

jobs.name: lint
jobs.purpose: Enforce code quality and style standards via ESLint

jobs.name: unit-tests
jobs.purpose: Execute unit tests for component and function logic

jobs.name: rules-tests
jobs.purpose: Validate Firebase security rules using emulators

jobs.name: deploy-staging
jobs.purpose: Deploy application to Vercel preview environment for testing

jobs.name: setup-staging-auth
jobs.purpose: Seed test data and generate authentication tokens for E2E tests

jobs.name: test-staging-desktop
jobs.purpose: Execute comprehensive desktop E2E tests across multiple user roles

jobs.name: test-staging-mobile
jobs.purpose: Execute mobile viewport E2E tests for responsive design validation

jobs.name: test-staging-performance
jobs.purpose: Execute performance and load tests on staging environment

jobs.name: deploy-production
jobs.purpose: Promote validated build to production environment

tests.name: ESLint Code Quality
tests.coverage: Code style, best practices, potential bugs

tests.name: Performance Tests
tests.coverage: Load times, navigation performance, runtime metrics

tests.name: Production Smoke Tests
tests.reason: Production uses real Firebase OAuth, no automated test login available
tests.alternative: Manual testing via npm run test:e2e:prod:setup && npm run test:e2e:prod:auth
tests.impact: No automated production validation after deployment

gaps.title: No Code Coverage Enforcement
gaps.description: Unit tests run but coverage metrics are not collected or enforced
gaps.impact: Cannot track test coverage trends or enforce minimum thresholds
gaps.recommendation: Add coverage collection to unit-tests job and set minimum threshold (e.g., 80%)

gaps.title: No Production Validation
gaps.description: Production smoke tests are disabled, no automated production validation
gaps.impact: Production issues may not be detected immediately after deployment
gaps.recommendation: Implement basic health check endpoint and validate after production deploy

gaps.title: No Accessibility Testing
gaps.description: No automated accessibility (a11y) testing in pipeline
gaps.impact: Accessibility regressions may be introduced without detection
gaps.recommendation: Add axe-core or similar a11y testing to E2E suite

gaps.title: No Visual Regression Testing
gaps.impact: UI changes may introduce unintended visual bugs
gaps.recommendation: Add Percy, Chromatic, or Playwright screenshot comparison

gaps.title: No Build Artifact Caching
gaps.description: Build artifacts are not cached between jobs
gaps.impact: Redundant build time in deploy-staging and deploy-production
gaps.recommendation: Cache build artifacts and reuse across jobs

gaps.title: No API Contract Testing
gaps.description: No explicit API contract or integration testing
gaps.impact: Backend/Firebase integration changes may break frontend
gaps.recommendation: Add API contract tests using Pact or similar

gaps.title: No Security Scanning
gaps.description: No dependency vulnerability scanning or SAST
gaps.impact: Vulnerable dependencies may be deployed to production
gaps.recommendation: Add npm audit or Snyk scanning to Phase 1

gaps.title: No Performance Budgets
gaps.description: Performance tests run but no clear pass/fail criteria
gaps.impact: Performance regressions may not block deployment
gaps.recommendation: Define performance budgets and fail tests if exceeded

gaps.title: Limited Test Parallelization
gaps.description: E2E tests could be further parallelized with sharding
gaps.impact: Test execution time could be reduced
gaps.recommendation: Use Playwright sharding for faster test execution

gaps.title: Missing Test Documentation
gaps.description: No inline documentation about what each test suite validates
gaps.impact: Difficult for new developers to understand test coverage
gaps.recommendation: Add comments or external test plan documentation

gaps.title: No Rollback Procedure
gaps.description: No documented rollback procedure if production deployment fails
gaps.recommendation: Document Vercel rollback process or implement automated rollback
